title: Cheap, cheap,  cheap
text:
Cheap, cheap, cheap. I realized these wouldn't be top quality towels but these are only a nudge above dollar store bath towels!

I've bought other Amazon branded towels in the past. These are very, very flimsy! They give off a great deal of lint in the dryer too.

( The Amazon Pinzon towels are the best: thick, absorbent and nearly lint free in dryer.)
